Agenda
Item 1
Internal Audit Plan for FY2021

The committee discussed the Internal Audit Plan for FY2021, a review of the company's compliance with environmental laws. The committee reviewed the company's environmental impact and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Item 2
Treasury Report: Cash Position and Investment Policy

The Treasury Report: Cash Position and Investment Policy was a review of the company's compliance with criminal laws. The committee reviewed the company's internal controls and confirmed that they were effective in preventing criminal activity.

Item 3
Political Action Committee (PAC) Contribution Strategy

The Political Action Committee (PAC) Contribution Strategy was a review of the company's compliance with antitrust laws. The committee reviewed the company's competitive practices and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Item 4
Foreign Exchange Hedging Policy Review

A special review of the Foreign Exchange Hedging Policy Review was conducted in light of the recent acquisition of National Alliance for Executive Compensation Research. Navid Lange outlined the plan for harmonizing policies and systems. The committee approved the integration plan in principle, pending final due diligence.
